name: sellify
description: Research and create ads with AI: sales angles, image ads, competitor ad and brand research, and your Meta ad results in your Sellify workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Sellify is an AI ad creative tool. It turns your products into ready-to-run image ads for Facebook and Instagram, shows you what ads competitors are running so you know what to make, and reads how your own Meta ads are doing. Connect your Sellify workspace to create and research ads from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Look up the products in your workspace, and create or update them, including drafting a product from its store page. Add product photos and research documents you share in the chat.
- Generate sales angles for a product, and pick the ones you want to build ads from.
- Create image ads for a product, including recreating a winning ad from Sellify's winning ads library with your own product, then generate more variations, edit the image, or change the headline and button text.
- Set up your brand kit (logo, colors, fonts and voice) from your website, so every ad uses it.
- Search Ad Spy for ads by keyword, product, or brand to see what competitors are running, and save searches to run again later.
- Research a competitor brand: its longest-running ads, the landing pages it sends traffic to, what it is testing, and its closest competitors.
- See the hook and angle of any ad, and get a transcript or scene-by-scene breakdown of video ads.
- Browse Expert Picks and save the ads you like to your workspace.
- Follow brands, see the new ads they launched, and turn on a daily or weekly email digest.
- See how your Meta ads are performing: spend, results, and your best campaigns and ads. Read only; nothing in Meta is changed.
- Organize generated ads on boards, download them, and delete or restore them.
- Search the Sellify Help Centre, or send a question or problem report to the Sellify team.

Every result includes a link that opens the item in the Sellify app, where you can review it, download it, or keep working.

Who it's for: brands, marketers, media buyers, and creative teams who already use Sellify.

Limitations:
- Requires an existing Sellify account. You sign in and choose one workspace when you connect, and Sellify only acts in that workspace.
- Actions that generate ads, angles, or Ad Spy results use your workspace's existing credits. Each call states the most it may spend, and a daily limit applies to each connection.
- Launching ads on Meta happens in the Sellify app. ChatGPT can read your Meta ad results but never creates, changes, or pauses campaigns.
- Deleted ads go to Recently deleted first. Deleting them for good asks you to confirm.
- Billing and account settings are managed in the Sellify app, not in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: List the products in my Sellify workspace.
Generate sales angles for my best-selling product.
What is Gymshark testing in its ads right now?

positive.description: List the products in the connected workspace
positive.prompt: What products do I have in Sellify?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the products in the test workspace by name, each with a link that opens the product in the Sellify app.

positive.description: Generate sales angles for a product and return them when ready
positive.prompt: Use Sellify to generate 3 new sales angles for the Cold Plunge Tub product.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the product, queues a batch of 3 angles with a max_credits cap, checks the status until the batch finishes, then lists the new angles with a link to the product's angles in Sellify.

positive.description: Search Ad Spy for competitor ads
positive.prompt: Use Sellify Ad Spy to show me ads competitors are running for cold plunge tubs.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs an Ad Spy search for cold plunge tubs and summarizes the competitor ads found, including advertiser, ad copy, and format.

positive.description: Recreate a winning ad with the user's product
positive.prompt: Pick a winning ad from the Sellify library that fits the Cold Plunge Tub and make a version of it for my product.
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses a suitable winning ad and queues an image ad for the Cold Plunge Tub with a max_credits cap, asking the user to confirm a higher credit cap if needed, then reports the status. Asking again once it finishes returns the generated ads with a link to open them in Sellify.

positive.description: Organize generated ads on a new board
positive.prompt: In Sellify, create a board called Review Test and add my two most recent ads to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a board named Review Test, finds the two most recent generated ads in the library, adds them to the board, and returns a link to the board in Sellify.

negative.description: Launching ads on Meta is not supported in ChatGPT. Sellify should not attempt it and should point the user to the Sellify app instead.
negative.prompt: Launch my newest ad on Facebook with a $50 daily budget.

negative.description: Deleting a Sellify account is not available through the plugin. Sellify should not attempt it or delete workspace data, and should point the user to account settings in the Sellify app.
Purchases are not handled in ChatGPT. Sellify should not sell credits, show plans, or link to a checkout; it should say credits are managed in the Sellify app.

review.commerce_description: Sellify does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Actions use credits from the user's existing Sellify account, and billing is managed only in the Sellify app.

publication.release_notes: Competitor brand research (longest-running ads, landing pages, creative tests and closest competitors), ad hooks and video breakdowns, Expert Picks, read-only Meta ad results, photo and document uploads, headline and button text edits on finished ads, and support requests from the chat.
